_comment: THE STRESS CORPUS. Mined from a mod repo's 278 commits and 258 catalogued features, read as the wishes a child would have typed. Supported kinds are replayed by the stress gates; kind='unsupported' cases are NOT tests -- they are demand evidence for wish classes we cannot express yet, kept here so they cannot be forgotten. Prefer the words actually typed, typos and all.
